numeric_scope: Read completed comparisons of all values in ten scientific outputs, all180 frames, dtype, affine/qform/sform, loaded and stored headers. Eleven normal outputs retain worker hashes. No numerical recalculation or image export.
source_input_scope: Workers and completed controller verified actual imports, whole source closures, full inputs and controls before/after execution. Readout binds these saved proofs and current immutable declaration/control hashes; individual image files are not reloaded.
API_clock_scope: Each normal cold API includes raw input, full compute, final saves and surrounding CUDA synchronization. Imports, locks, source/input/output validation and final live-sample handshake excluded.
process_clock_scope: Fresh child process through exit, including one API, imports, locks, validation and final live-sample handshake. Child user/system clocks include NVIDIA-monitor subprocesses.
stage_clock_scope: Existing nested observer host-wall clocks and production pipeline clocks. They are not independently synchronized CUDA kernels and cannot be added into the API clock.
performance_scope: One old/new cold pair per backend, ordered FNIRT baseline/candidate then SynthMorph candidate/baseline. Four calls are not same-case ABBA. Shared GPU observations do not establish stable speed or performance equivalence.
memory_scope: Exact Torch allocation/reservation peaks plus sampled owned NVIDIA process-tree memory and final-live-sample acknowledgement. Sampled physical peak is not a continuous maximum.
privacy: Anonymous roles, sizes, hashes and aggregate metrics only; paths, subjects, PID, raw UUID and individual images/arrays remain private.
